title: ID0455120-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R6 170001959] SafetyRelay_QA26
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Hello, since the update was installed on Friday, the charger is showing the following error message: SafetyRelay_QA26. Please bring the charger back online as soon as possible! A restart via Sifinity Control has already been carried out. Thanks.
Solution:  it seems that the equipment is working fine again. it seems that the
Safety Relais 3SK was tripped ( Door was opened )
